getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:95b89e2a-f57.description: About Wing Wing is one of the world's largest virtual talent companies, venture-backed and based in San Francisco. Leveraging our scale, millions of applicants, and operational expertise, we’re expanding into next-generation AI products. Across both parts of our business, we help businesses automate their workflows, scale their operations, and leverage top global talent. We’re now building an in-house video content engine to showcase our products, educate SMBs, and create engaging, high-quality content across YouTube, TikTok, paid ads, landing pages, and more. About the Role We are hiring a full-time Content Creator & On-Camera Talent to produce compelling product walkthroughs, educational videos, thought-leadership content, UGC-style ads, and industry-specific explainers for our company. You will film yourself & your screen regularly, create scripts, edit videos, record your screen while on camera, collaborate on creative concepts, and produce 3–5 videos per week across multiple formats. You’ll work closely with our marketing and product teams. You will have a lot of autonomy to suggest content and have a high degree of impact. This is a highly creative, high-leverage role that will directly shape our company's (and sister brands') public identity. In short, you will have a ton of impact in this role. Responsibilities Content Production - Film yourself on camera for short-form and long-form video content (YouTube, TikTok, Facebook/Instagram, LinkedIn, product pages, ads). - Produce multiple polished videos per week, including: Product tutorials & walkthroughs; Explainer videos for SMBs across multiple industries (law firms, HVAC, real estate, med spa, home services, etc.); UGC-style testimonial ads for paid performance channels; Sales enablement content: objection handling, use-case stories, etc; How-to and onboarding videos for customers; Thought leadership, commentary, and trend breakdowns. Scriptwriting & Creative Development - Write clear, engaging scripts and hooks. - Brainstorm video ideas aligned with business goals and trending content formats. - Localize content to feel authentically American in tone, delivery, and cultural reference. Video Editing & Post-Production - Edit videos for multiple platforms using tools like CapCut, Final Cut, Premiere, or similar. - Add subtitles, transitions, animations, screen recordings, and visual overlays. - Maintain consistent branding (music, colors, lower thirds, CTA styles). Technical Setup - Handle basic filming setup: lighting, framing, mic checks, stable camera use. - Willing to learn more advanced techniques for cleaner, more polished production. Tools & Tech - Use apps like Zapier, Make, n8n, Slack, and others to show off product automations. - Be tech-savvy enough to learn new tools (B2B tools like CRMs, Dialers, etc.) quickly. Collaboration & Operations - Work with marketing, product, and sales to align content with campaigns. - Join occasional on-location shoots with clients or internal teams. Requirements Must-Haves - Strong camera presence with a confident, friendly, and clear speaking voice. - Clear and fluent spoken English that US based customers can easily understand. - Comfortable filming yourself regularly and following scripts. - Experience editing videos (short-form or long-form). - Strong familiarity with social media platforms (YT, TikTok, Reels). - Tech-savvy - able to learn software tools quickly (CRMs, Zapier/Make.com, phone systems, automations, etc.). - Proactive, organized, and able to consistently hit weekly content output goals. Nice-to-Haves - Background in content creation, influencing, livestreaming, UGC, or on-camera work. - Interest in AI, tech, startups, or business automation. - Experience writing scripts or storyboards. - Familiarity with lighting setups, microphones, cameras. - Understanding of U.S. culture, humor, and SMB pain points. - Understanding of cameras, lighting, coloring - know how to adjust complex settings. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:f13e8cda-fd4.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:f13e8cda-fd4.description: About the Role We are looking for a high-leverage Executive Assistant to act as a strategic right hand to our CEO. This is not a typical administrative position. Beyond handling calendar management and travel coordination in a fast-paced, chaotic environment, you will play an active role in driving operational efficiency. We need a clear-thinking, proactive problem solver who can jump right in without needing hand-holding. You will analyze data, build reports, identify operational gaps, and bring solutions to the table before issues arise. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive Operations & Gatekeeping Act as the primary point of contact and buffer for the CEO, managing internal and external communications with tact and judgment. Maintain complete situational awareness of the CEO’s priorities, deadlines, and ongoing projects. Manage complex, fluid calendars across multiple time zones, adjusting dynamically to continuous travel schedule changes. Handle seamless international travel arrangements, itineraries, and logistics. 2. Data Analysis & Business Intelligence Gather data across departments to create clear, actionable executive reports, dashboards, and presentations. Continuously audit workflows and metrics to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and areas for process improvement. Conduct research and synthesize complex information into quick, digestible briefs for decision-making. 3. Financial & Administrative Support Assist with financial tracking, expense management, budget auditing, and financial reporting. Monitor key financial indicators and track cross-departmental deliverables to ensure projects remain on budget and on schedule. Handle confidential business and financial information with high discretion. Requirements & Qualifications Turnkey Capability: Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief Of Staff, Business Operations Manager, or Strategic Coordinator. You can drop into a fast-moving environment on Day 1 without requiring extensive training. High IQ & Analytical Thinking: Exceptional logic and problem-solving ability. You don't just report data; you understand what the numbers mean and recommend action. Proactive & Autonomous: You anticipate needs before they are voiced and actively look for ways to lighten the CEO's operational load. Chaos Tolerance: High adaptability, mental resilience, and composure in fast-changing, high-pressure environments. Financial Literacy: Comfort with numbers, spreadsheets, financial statements, and basic business finance principles. Time Zone Agility: Willingness and technical setup to work asynchronously and align with the CEO’s shifting global schedule. Tech Savvy: Advanced proficiency in modern workspace tools (e.g., Claude, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Excel/Google Sheets, project management platforms).

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ca64ad1f-b746-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mortgage SaaS Account Executive based in the United States. This is a high-impact enterprise sales role focused on transforming how mortgage lenders, servicers, and credit unions access and manage insurance information. You’ll build and scale a pipeline of national and regional financial institutions while owning the sales process from initial outreach through close. The role combines consultative selling, technical discovery, and strategic account development in a complex B2B SaaS environment. You’ll work closely with prospects through pilots, security and compliance reviews, and production implementation to drive successful conversions. You’ll also expand revenue within existing accounts by understanding evolving customer needs and connecting them with relevant product capabilities. This is a fully remote opportunity suited to an early-stage GTM professional who thrives in an ownership-driven, fast-moving environment. Success in the role will directly contribute to revenue growth and the modernization of insurance workflows across the mortgage ecosystem. Build and manage a strong enterprise sales pipeline through targeted phone, email, social media, industry networking, and other outbound channels. Identify, engage, qualify, and close new business opportunities with mortgage lenders, mortgage servicers, and credit unions. Lead consultative discovery conversations that focus on understanding customer challenges, operational workflows, and business objectives rather than relying on transactional sales tactics. Own complex sales cycles involving technical scoping, information security, legal, regulatory, procurement, and other stakeholder reviews. Guide prospective customers through pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives, taking a hands-on approach to maximize conversion into production contracts. Develop tailored pricing packages and commercial proposals aligned with customer requirements and secure the necessary internal approvals. Prepare comprehensive sales meeting strategies, including agendas, presentations, demos, scripts, and supporting materials. Grow ARR within existing accounts by maintaining a deep understanding of customer needs and connecting those needs to current and upcoming product capabilities. Partner closely with customers throughout production projects to support successful adoption, retention, and expansion. Contribute industry expertise and thought leadership through articles, posts, events, and other content that strengthens market positioning. Attend trade shows, industry events, and networking opportunities to develop relationships with prospects and strategic partners. Operate with strong ownership, transparency, creativity, and collaboration in a distributed, fast-paced environment. Requirements Proven quota-carrying experience selling SaaS software to mortgage companies, mortgage servicers, or credit unions. Demonstrated success managing complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close, including technical, information security, legal, and regulatory reviews. Deep knowledge of the mortgage, credit union, or insurance industry and a strong understanding of the challenges facing financial institutions that manage insurance information. Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to uncover business needs, establish credibility, and position solutions around measurable customer value. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with particular strength in clear, persuasive, and responsive written communication. Ability to operate effectively in an early-stage or scaling GTM environment where priorities evolve and individuals are expected to take significant ownership. Strong organizational, pipeline management, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Proficiency with CRM, lead-management, and other modern sales technologies
